title: Modular contract bundles, pricing experiments, and SQ portal pilot for enterprise onboarding
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Summary: Pilot a self-serve Security Questionnaire (SQ) portal combined with modular contract bundles and targeted pricing experiments to accelerate enterprise procurement. Background: Sales and Customer Success report onboarding friction around variable SOC2 evidence, insurance negotiation, and rigid contract/legal review processes. Large prospects stall at procurement due to unclear pricing for mixed deployment modes (Hosted/Dedicated/Private) and multiple add-ons (SLA retention, private deployment support, extended observability). Goals: 1) Build a lightweight SQ portal that routes required evidence to the right team (Legal/Infra/Security) and produces a packaged 'SOC2 bundle' artifact for procurement; 2) Offer 3 modular contract bundles (Core, Secure, Compliant) with clear pricing deltas and optional insurance credit tables; 3) Run A/B pricing experiments on bundle prices and commit discounts to quantify conversion lift and time-to-Signature improvements. Success metrics: a) Reduce average procurement cycle time from LOI to contract signature by 30% for pilot cohort; b) Increase conversion rate of RfP-stage enterprise opportunities by +12 percentage points in A/B test variant; c) Decrease number of manual evidence requests per deal by 60%; d) Measure incremental ARR attributable to bundle adoption. Scope: Includes design and delivery of SQ portal flows (self-serve evidence upload + auto-routing), contract bundle templates (legal-approved), pricing experiment configurations, and a small pilot with 6-8 prospects. Out of scope: Full procurement marketplace integration, automated insurance underwriting, and changes to global pricing tiers beyond pilot cohort. Approach: - Sprint 1: Product & Legal agreement on bundle terms and insurance credit rules; create contract templates. - Sprint 2: Build SQ portal MVP (forms, file upload, basic routing rules, Slack/email notifications). - Sprint 3: Configure pricing experiment framework (feature flags, analytics segmentation, billing integration). - Pilot: Run with targeted AE/SalesOps group, collect metrics and feedback, iterate. Acceptance criteria: - SQ portal can accept SOC2 artifacts, map them to checklist items and route to assigned reviewers; - Legal-approved Core/Secure/Compliant contract templates drafted and stored in Drive; - Pricing experiment live with at least two variants, tracked in Mixpanel or Segment; - Pilot engages at least 6 deals and produces measurable delta on procurement cycle time. Stakeholders: Product (Aisha Patel), Sales Lead (Devon Harris), Legal (Priya Menon), Security (Luca Romano), Engineering lead (Marco Li), Solutions Eng (Riley Chen), Customer Success (Anne Wu).
